plaatsen.tekst: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten ➔ us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
